applicability: Retail packages; the supplied summary excludes packages above 25 kg or 25 litres, subject to stated exceptions, and commodities supplied to industrial/institutional consumers.
requirement: Determine whether the package falls within the scope of the retail-package rules.
exceptions: Cement/fertilizer bags up to 50 kg; industrial/institutional consumer packages described in Rule 3.

requirement: Apply stated exemptions before running retail-package checks.
exceptions: Packages <=10 g or <=10 ml; fast food from restaurants/hotels; drug formulations under Drugs (Price Control) Order, 1995; agricultural produce packages above 50 kg. The supplied summary also notes special treatment for 10–20 g/ml packages.

requirement: A commodity must not be pre-packed for sale without required declarations on the label.
exceptions: Packages without RSP declaration may remain inside the manufacturer's premises but must have RSP before leaving.

applicability: Commodities listed in the Second Schedule.
requirement: Commodities covered by the Second Schedule must use the specified standard package quantities.
exceptions: The supplied summary states that the former non-standard-size declaration was withdrawn from 1 July 2012.

requirement: Declare the name and address of the manufacturer, packer or importer as applicable.
exceptions: If unqualified, the supplied summary states the name/address is presumed to be the manufacturer's; food products are noted as following the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act in the supplied summary.

requirement: Declare the common or generic name of the commodity.
exceptions: For multiple products in one package, the supplied summary requires quantity of each.

requirement: Declare net quantity in standard units of weight, measure or number as applicable.
exceptions: Unit selection is governed further by Rules 11–13 and the Fourth Schedule.

requirement: Declare month and year of manufacture, pre-packing or import as applicable.
exceptions: Bidis, incense sticks and specified LPG cylinders; cosmetics are noted as following Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 in the supplied summary.

requirement: Declare the retail sale price (MRP).
exceptions: Bidis; LPG under Administrative Price Mechanism; alcohol follows State Excise Laws according to the supplied summary.

applicability: Commodities for which dimensions are relevant.
requirement: Declare dimensions where relevant to the commodity.
exceptions: Applicability depends on commodity.

requirement: Provide consumer-care contact details including name, address, phone and email as described in the supplied summary.
exceptions: None stated in supplied summary.

requirement: Required declarations must not be altered or covered by stickers.
exceptions: Stickers may reduce MRP without covering the original MRP and may be used for non-mandatory information.

requirement: Multi-component commodities must carry declarations on the main package or on each part when sold as spares, as described in the supplied summary.
exceptions: Depends on package configuration.

requirement: Required numerals must satisfy the applicable minimum numeral height.
exceptions: Packages <=5 cm³ may use a card/tape as PDP; molded/blown values differ as stated in the source.

requirement: Letter width must be at least one-third of letter height, except specified characters.
exceptions: '1', 'i', 'I', 'l' as stated in supplied summary.

requirement: Required declarations must appear on the Principal Display Panel.
exceptions: Returnable soft-drink bottles may show MRP on the crown cap or bottle.

requirement: Maintain the specified clear space around quantity declarations.
exceptions: None stated in supplied summary.

requirement: Required declarations must be legible, prominent and in contrasting colour as applicable.
exceptions: Molded/blown glass/plastic and clear handwriting exceptions are stated in the supplied summary.

applicability: Liquid products where visibility is affected.
requirement: Required information must not require reading through liquid contents.
exceptions: None stated in supplied summary.

requirement: Required declarations must be in Hindi (Devanagari) or English; other languages may be added.
exceptions: Other languages may be additional.

requirement: Declare the full name and address of the manufacturer/packer/importer as applicable.
exceptions: Packages <=5 cm³ may use an identifying mark; foreign-made, India-packed goods require Indian packer/importer address according to supplied summary.

requirement: Net quantity excludes wrapper/packaging weight.
exceptions: None stated.

requirement: Do not use a “when packed” qualifier except for commodities covered by the Third Schedule.
exceptions: Third Schedule commodities such as soaps, lotions and creams as described in supplied summary.

requirement: Use an appropriate unit of mass, length, area, volume or number for the commodity.
exceptions: Fourth Schedule exceptions.

requirement: Do not use misleading quantity words such as “minimum”, “about”, “approximately” or “average”.
exceptions: Supplied summary notes amendments to misleading-word restrictions; verify current rule before legal deployment.

applicability: Packages within scope, subject to Fourth Schedule.
requirement: Use metric/SI units and the applicable smaller/larger unit conventions stated in the supplied summary.
exceptions: Fourth Schedule.

requirement: Items sold by number should use the symbol “N” or “U”.
exceptions: Commodity-specific exceptions.

requirement: Textiles such as bedsheets, sarees and towels must declare number and finished dimensions.
exceptions: Multiple sizes require individual price/dimension labels according to supplied summary.

applicability: Commodities whose price depends on size/weight.
requirement: Where price depends on size or weight, declare that relationship.
exceptions: Category-specific.

applicability: Foil, tissues, toilet paper and other specified sheet products.
requirement: Sheet products must declare number of usable sheets and dimensions.
exceptions: Category-specific.

applicability: Bags, boxes, cups and similar specified products.
requirement: Container-type products must declare number and applicable dimensions.
exceptions: Applicable dimensions depend on container type.

requirement: Packages must not be sold above MRP.
exceptions: Requires actual sale price context.

requirement: Printed MRP must not be altered or obliterated.
exceptions: Supplied summary describes tax-change notification procedure separately.

requirement: Physical package quantity testing uses prescribed sample sizes and procedures.
exceptions: None stated.

requirement: Lot approval requires average net quantity at least the declared quantity, no sample exceeding MPE deficiency, and required declarations present.
exceptions: Testing follows prescribed schedules.

requirement: Wholesale packages must declare manufacturer/importer/packer name and address, commodity identity, and either number of retail packages or total net quantity.
exceptions: Exempted where another law already requires similar declarations according to supplied summary.

applicability: Export packages subsequently sold in India.
requirement: Export packages cannot be sold in India unless repacked/relabelled according to Chapter II requirements.
exceptions: Requires import/export and sale context.

requirement: Manufacturers, packers and importers must register as described in the supplied summary.
exceptions: Requires business/registration records.

requirement: An advertisement quoting MRP must also declare net quantity/number in the same font size as MRP.
exceptions: Requires advertisement context.

requirement: The supplied summary states penalties of ₹4,000 for specified Rules 27–31 violations and ₹2,000 for other rules without a specified penalty.
exceptions: Actual penalty applicability should be verified against the current law.

requirement: Central Government may relax rules temporarily in the circumstances described in the supplied summary.
exceptions: Requires official approval/case information.

requirement: Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) depends on declared quantity and whether measurement is by weight/volume, length, area or number.
exceptions: Commodity-specific testing requirements may apply.

requirement: Listed commodities must follow their specified standard package sizes.
exceptions: Commodity-specific.

requirement: “When packed” qualifier may be used for specified commodities affected by natural variation.
exceptions: Supplied examples: soaps, lotions, creams excluding milk cream.

requirement: Certain commodities use special permitted units as specified in the Fourth Schedule.
exceptions: Examples in supplied summary include aerosols, curd, electric cable/wire, fruits, ready-made garments, tyres/tubes, ice cream and yarn.

requirement: Official quantity testing uses prescribed sample sizes based on lot size.
exceptions: Supplied summary gives examples for lot sizes below/above 4000.

requirement: Official testing covers tare weight, net weight and volume/length verification methods.
exceptions: None stated.

requirement: Official inspection results are recorded using prescribed inspection data-sheet forms.
exceptions: Forms A and B described in supplied summary.
